item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-25
item.description:
Our open-source research community has seen a flurry of activity across multiple projects. Notably, the `statcheck` and `escicheck` projects have made administrative updates and synchronized with external versions, respectively, to ensure their tools remain up-to-date and functional. Meanwhile, `oddpub` has improved its ontogenerator with a code validation update, and `docpluck` has addressed several issues, including recovering residual prose shapes and updating documentation. The `coarse` project has re-enabled Fable 5 in its model picker, and `regcheck` has fixed various bugs, including issues with its demo page, card preview, and survey routes. These updates demonstrate the community's commitment to maintaining and improving its research tools, and we celebrate the progress made across these projects.

5 commits across 4 active repositories this week.
